text:
Homage to the Victorious Ones.

I bow down. To all the Victorious Ones of the past, future, and present, you are the Mother, O Virtuous One. You are the Goddess, the child of the Victorious Ones. You possess a nature that is the nature of non-nature. I shall speak the name of her who has become the Mother of the Buddhas, O Virtuous One. Those who desire to attain it, listen.

The Perfection of Wisdom, Omniscience, and the knowledge of all aspects of the path.

<summary>This text serves as an introductory homage and invocation to the Perfection of Wisdom, identifying her as the Mother of all Buddhas and the source of omniscience.</summary>
<keywords>Perfection of Wisdom, Prajnaparamita, Homage, Omniscience, Mother of Buddhas</keywords>
